opportunities.name: Trip.com attraction search by city and keyword
opportunities.description: On Trip.com Attractions & Tickets, search a destination city for a keyword, sort the results by a chosen order and open a result to see its price and details.
steps: Open Trip.com and go to Attractions & Tickets
Type the destination city and pick it from the suggestions
Type the keyword in the Keywords field
Pick the sort order (Top Rated / Lowest Price)
Open the attraction you want from the results
Look at the attraction's price and details (Nearby, View Tickets)

instances.values: Hong Kong; 'Park'; Top Rated; opened Shanghai Wild Animal Park

opportunities.description: On qatarairways.com, go from the Experience menu to the Baggage allowance page and open the tab for a chosen cabin class to see its allowance table.

Click 'Baggage allowance' under Before you fly
